description: Set or update environment variables for an app (merges with existing). The app must be restarted or redeployed for changes to take effect.

vars.description: Key-value pairs to set as environment variables, e.g. { "API_KEY": "...", "NODE_ENV": "production" }

name: vibekit_set_env

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Confirmation of the updated environment variables.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Set Env Vars
